content:
Not all chargers (power banks) are created equal. Among the best designs I've seen — some with built-in displays, capable of charging two MacBooks simultaneously, RGB lighting effects, and solid metal enclosures featuring two windows to showcase the internals — Sharge's newly launched Shargeek 300 charger is an absolute standout, and you should definitely check it out while it's on this limited-time deal. Here's my hands-on impression.

Sharge Shargeek 300 Charger Review

The brand-new Sharge Shargeek 300 charger features a solid metal enclosure with a 24,000mAh battery capacity, delivering up to 300W of power to your devices. With its transparent design, RGB lighting effects, and built-in display as the main highlights, it's currently available on Amazon at a launch sale price of $199.

Feature Overview:

  • 300W total output — charge 2 laptops + 1 smartphone simultaneously
  • CNC aluminum alloy enclosure with advanced thermal management
  • 24,000mAh battery capacity — fully airline-compliant
  • Equipped with dual USB-C, USB-A, and adjustable DC output (5V–28V)
  • Provides stable power for Starlink, portable refrigerators, soldering irons, camera monitors, LED panel lights, and other DC-powered devices
  • 140W USB-C input — Shargeek 300 goes from 0% to 100% in just 44 minutes
  • Full-tab battery cells — operating temperature reduced by up to 35%
  • 1.9-inch smart display with Sentinel BMS — real-time charging and discharging power curves, individual cell voltage, cycle count, usage records, and estimated time remaining

9to5Toys Verdict

In my opinion, Sharge is an underrated brand. Their charging products are among the best-looking on the market, and the new Shargeek 300 charger is the prime example.

This thing is absolutely gorgeous. Not everyone loves this transparent, cyberpunk aesthetic — exposed internals, RGB lighting, and a built-in display — but I do, and I'm sure you'll fall in love once you see it in person.

What you're looking at is a one-piece CNC metal enclosure — most chargers on the market with displays use plastic shells... I really hate those designs, but I love what Sharge has done. This thing is built like a tank.

As far as I'm concerned, this machine is stunningly beautiful — so good-looking that I'd happily keep it on my desk as a display piece.

This brand's products have never disappointed me or had any issues. Honestly, if you haven't been paying attention to this brand, you really should. I've been testing this brand-new Shargeek 300W charger for about a month now, and that's consistently been the case.

Regarding the power output distribution, the total is 300W. When all three USB ports are used simultaneously, the two main USB-C ports each output 140W, while the traditional USB-A provides an additional 20W of power. As far as I've seen, charging three devices simultaneously is absolutely more than enough, since I rarely need more than one or two devices when I'm out.

Sharge says that using USB-C1 or USB-C2 alone to charge your MacBook Pro from "0% to 50%" takes approximately 25 to 30 minutes. My test results matched perfectly — my 14-inch Pro went from nearly dead to just over 50% in 27 minutes.

Alright, let's talk about the display. I absolutely love the vibe — slightly retro, yet ultra-modern at the same time. I never get tired of looking at it.

Functionally, it basically displays all the information anyone would need, plus plenty of stuff I don't need — real-time charging status, discharging power curves (I don't really care about these, but I love watching them), individual cell voltage, cycle count, usage records, and so on. As far as I've seen, everything works great, and more importantly, every time I pull it out to use it, it gives me a *Blade Runner* or *Cyberpunk 2077* vibe.

For power-hungry enthusiasts and true professionals who can make good use of this kind of charging and voltage analytics data, this is the most comprehensive power data suite I've seen on any consumer-grade charger.

Alright, I've found my new favorite charger — this thing performs as well as it looks, and it will be part of my everyday gear for the foreseeable future.
